<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
You are a research agent on a team building a Max4Live recreation of the Intellijel Metropolix sequencer. Your task is to research PRESETS, STORAGE, CTRL KNOBS, and GLOBAL SETTINGS.

READ THE PDF at /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/metropolix_menu.pdf - read pages 160-193. Also check earlier sections for preset and ctrl knob references. The PDF is 193 pages.

Focus on documenting:
1. Preset storage - up to 64 presets, what is stored in each preset
2. What is NOT stored in a preset (global settings)
3. Preset recall - instant or morphing/interpolation
4. CTRL knobs - how many, what they control, assignment options
5. Global settings - list all global configuration options
6. Any MIDI implementation (MIDI CC mappings, program change for preset recall)
7. Firmware/system settings
8. Any calibration or setup parameters

For M4L implementation: Presets should use the pattr/autopattr system. CTRL knobs become live.dial parameters. Document exactly what goes into a preset vs what is stored globally. Consider how preset recall would work with pattrstorage in M4L.

Write your findings to /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/.research/07_presets_global.md

After writing your file, mark task #7 as completed, then read ALL other research files in /Users/user1303836/Development/maxmsp-utils/.research/ and send a message to "plan-writer" with a summary of your findings and any cross-cutting concerns.
</teammate-message>
